page.overview:
Who is Djedida?

Djedida was the secretary to Korba, and was one of the Fremen Naibs accused by Bijaz as a traitor against the Atreides Empire.

In a deleted scene from Dune Messiah, Djedida flees with Bikouros and Cahueit into the desert upon realising their betrayal will be revealed, ostensibly being escorted as a Qizarate observer.
